text.p: Rabobank Investment Ltd started coverage of Hungarian gas distributor Primagaz Hungaria Rt with a 'hold' recommendation, saying the company had to face strong competition while its shares were not cheap.
"After considering the valuation of other similar international companies and the valuation of the Hungarian market, we recommend holding shares," analyst Anthony Vago said in a report.
Vago said Primagaz was planning to dramatically increase its bulk market share, adding that "the company is facing increasing competition from Shell in both the cylinder and bulk markets."
The analyst expected Primagaz's earnings per share to amount to 498.7 forints in 1997 and 676.4 forints in 1998.
Rabobank Investment Ltd is the securities arm of Rabobank Hungaria, which is a unit of Rabobank Nederland.
